paragraph: This book has become **widely** read in our country. Steel is a **widely**-used material in civil construction. I know a poet whose poems are **widely** read.
english: by many people or in many places

paragraph: It is estimated that 1.5 billion children **worldwide** are missing school. Russian is spoken by over 150 million people **worldwide**. Weather scientists said May 2020 was the warmest month on record **worldwide**.
english: spanning the world

paragraph: A friend in hand is worth two in the **bush**! We walked through thick **bushes**. Stop beating around the **bush** and answer my question!
english: category of woody plant
arabicDesc: مثال: صديق في اليد خير من اثنين على الشجرة!

paragraph: They had to call the police to **restore** order. It took five years to **restore** this historic building. How on earth can we **restore** our youth?
english: to reestablish, or bring back into existence

paragraph: I learned to play **guitar** when I was ten years old. Who is playing the **guitar**? I can teach you **guitar**.
english: a musical instrument with strings
arabicDesc: مثال: تعلمت العزف على الغيتار عندما كان عمري عشر سنوات.

paragraph: We will **trigger** a revolution in the IT industry. A crisis can **trigger** a revolution in economic thinking. He couldn't bring himself to pull the **trigger**.
english: finger-operated lever used to fire a gun

paragraph: I'm just a **plain** old office worker. It is **plain** that you have done this before. It's quite **plain** that you haven't been paying attention.
english: simple, unaltered

other.meaning: An expanse of land with relatively low relief and few trees, especially a grassy expanse (noun)

paragraph: I have a pain in my **chest**. I saw your **chest** move. Do you have a file in the tool **chest**?
english: a box, now usually a large strong box with a secure convex lid

paragraph: My **cousins** are coming in a few days. Him and me are **cousins**. Currently, my **cousin** is a professor of Foreign Languages.
english: child of a person’s parent’s brother or sister
arabicDesc: مثال: سيأتي أولاد عمي بعد بضعة أيام.

paragraph: The tax cut is supposed to **boost** capital investment. Businesses are seeing a **boost** in their online sales. He was attempting to give me a **boost**.
english: to increase or improve something

paragraph: This is just a **symptom** of a bigger problem. Being on time is a **symptom** of a boring life. What evil is Trump a **symptom** of?
english: a signal

paragraph: He took the early **retirement** package the company offered. It's never too early to start saving for **retirement**. My mother-in-law lives in a **retirement** community.
english: an act of retiring

paragraph: As a starting class, I think **warrior** is good. A **warrior** defends his house at all cost! The figure of a **warrior** is highlighted in that huge painting.
english: a person who is actively engaged in battle, conflict or warfare

paragraph: The ideas for the **comedy** show are all boring. Reality is the funniest **comedy** in the world. I like to see **comedy** in the theater.
english: dramatic work that is light and humorous or satirical in tone

paragraph: This will be the crowning **achievement** of my career. Great difficulties stand in the way of its **achievement**. They awarded him a gold medal for his **achievement**.
english: the act of achieving or performing

paragraph: The **vessel** has a length of 30 meters. The **vessel** was surrounded by water. Do not look upon the **vessel** but upon that which it contains.
english: a craft for transportation on or in water, air, or space

paragraph: Workers in these factories comprise a large percentage of **immigrants**. She married a fellow **immigrant** and had a son. She fell in love with a Russian **immigrant**.
english: person who comes to a country to settle
arabicDesc: مثال: العمال في هذه المعامل يشكلون نسبة كبيرة من المهاجرين.

paragraph: The **employer** made a new offer to the workers. He had words with his **employer** and was fired. I saw his former **employer** at a conference.
english: person or entity which employs others
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: رب عمل، ربة عمل، صاحبة عمل

paragraph: He decided to take her **suggestion**. An interesting **suggestion**. I'll have to think it over. If anyone has a better **suggestion**, let's hear it.
english: something suggested

paragraph: He entered up the **sum** in his account book. Every even number is the **sum** of two primes. It took a large **sum** to buy this watch.
english: a quantity obtained by addition or aggregation

paragraph: That would give him an attack **bonus** of two. They even paid up front with a crazy **bonus**. I blew my whole **bonus** on shopping and travel.
english: something extra that is good

paragraph: I have no **intention** of seeing him. That was not my **intention**. Actions are to be judged by their **intentions**.
english: a course of action that a person intends to follow

paragraph: Get hold of the **rail** just in case. The port is connected to the **rail** network. He hopped the fence to the **rail** yard.
english: a metal bar for trains; also a bar to hold

paragraph: The brothers had a hot **dispute** on her marriage. They feared that the **dispute** would hurt the economy. That **dispute** has been settled once and for all.
english: 1. argument, failure to agree

paragraph: The West destroys oil and resource-rich countries to spread peace and **democracy**. **Democracy** is the worst form of government, except all the others that have been tried. Look at how much **democracy** means to this country!
english: rule by the people
arabicDesc: مثال: تقوم الدّول الغربيّة بتدمير الدّول الغنيّة بالنّفط و الموارد كي تزرع السّلام و الديمقراطيّة.

paragraph: **Cheer** him up when you see him. I tried to **cheer** him up. Stop trying to **cheer** me up.
english: to shout to show support or happiness

paragraph: Polish **nails** are more expensive than the Chinese ones. I think you hit the **nail** on the head. He thinks he's hit the **nail** on the head.
english: the basal thickened portion of the anterior wings of certain hemiptera
arabicDesc: مثال: المسامير البولندية أغلى من الصينية.

other.meaning: spike-shaped metal fastener used for joining wood or similar materials

paragraph: The **musical** is starting soon. The company manufactures a wide variety of **musical** instruments. Everyone in my family can play a **musical** instrument.
english: of or relating to music

other.meaning: A stage performance, show or film that involves singing, dancing and musical numbers performed by the cast as well as acting (noun)

paragraph: The man wore a mask of a **tiger**. Was he a **tiger** in bed? We scared the **tiger** off.
english: the mammal Panthera tigris

paragraph: I heard a noise in the **bedroom**. We live in a three-**bedroom** house. The **bedroom** window was open.
english: room in a house where a bed is kept for sleeping
arabicDesc: مثال: سمعتُ صوتا في غرفة النوم.

paragraph: He made a **medal** of gold. Who do you think will get the gold **medal**? He was given a gold **medal** for his achievements.
english: a stamped metal disc used as a personal ornament, a charm, or a religious object

paragraph: She is the one who took care of his **wound**. It's possible that the victim is **wounded** in the head. He was **wounded** in the fight.
english: an injury, such as a cut, stab, or tear, to a (usually external) part of the body

other.meaning: To hurt or injure (someone) by cutting, piercing, or tearing the skin (verb)

paragraph: The Internet is not a result of free **enterprise**. Your success in the **enterprise** depends on your effort. No wonder that he has failed in the **enterprise**.
english: a company, business, organization, or other purposeful endeavor

paragraph: Social **interaction** is the very foundation of social life. **Interaction** with your kids is essential for their growth. I expect respect in every **interaction** I have.
english: the situation or occurrence in which two or more things act upon one another to produce an effect

paragraph: The **sand** on the beach is very hot. The president is burying his head in the **sand**. She sat down on the **sand** next to him.
english: finely ground rock
arabicDesc: مثال: الرمل على الشاطىء حار جدا

paragraph: You are very **attractive** in blue. I think she is very **attractive**. The teacher is so **attractive**.
english: having the quality of attracting by inherent force
arabicDesc: مثال: شكلك جميل وأنت تلبس الأزرق.

paragraph: They are watching what's happening **closely**. The two countries are **closely** related to each other. Even if you look **closely**, you don't see anything.
english: carefully; also near
arabicDesc: مثال: إنهم يراقبون ما يحدث عن كثب.

paragraph: Why do you **constantly** have to get involved? I am **constantly** forgetting names. I **constantly** went over this problem in my mind.
english: all the time

paragraph: We **hardly** ever see you around here. The express train went by so fast we **hardly** saw it. I can **hardly** hear you.
english: almost not
arabicDesc: مثال: من الصعب أن نراك هنا.

paragraph: The class is **officially** over. The United States **officially** declared a state of emergency. The deal was also **officially** signed that day.
english: in an official manner
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد انتهى الدّرس بشكل رسمي.

paragraph: I thought you said you couldn't eat **raw** fish. I can't resist the urge to eat **raw** meat. When it comes to **raw** fish, I feel disgusted.
english: (of food) Not cooked

paragraph: They haven't seen you since **secondary** school. My son will be starting **secondary** school in September. You're like someone I was at **secondary** school with.
english: next in order to the first or primary
arabicDesc: مثال: لم يروك منذ أن كنت في المتوسطة.

paragraph: The problem is that **solar** energy costs too much. These are the planets of our **solar** system. We must make the best use of **solar** energy.
english: of or pertaining to the sun
arabicDesc: مثال: المشكلة أن الطاقة الشمسية تكلف كثيرا.

paragraph: Can I help you **somehow**? **Somehow**, what we say always reveals what we feel. **Somehow** he managed to work his way through college.
english: in a way that is not known
arabicDesc: مثال: هل بإمكاني مساعدتك بطريقة ما؟

paragraph: Death is the **ultimate** truth. You can't understand my **ultimate** purpose in this world. The **ultimate** question for me is whether I like business.
english: final; also the best or greatest

paragraph: He looks like he has seen a **ghost**. There was a **ghost** above me. Are you watching this type of video? Alright. No more **ghost** stories.
english: spirit appearing after death
arabicDesc: مثال: يبدو و كأنه رأى شبحا.

paragraph: You can't go back into the past to **eliminate** yourself. I think he has plans to **eliminate** me. Many countries have signed a treaty to **eliminate** nuclear weapons.
english: to remove completely; to remove from a competition

paragraph: The population of this city is **decreasing** every year. An auto-reply like that would **decrease** email volume. What should you do to **decrease** your debt?
english: to become smaller in amount
arabicDesc: مثال: عدد سكان هذه المدينة يتناقص كل عام.

paragraph: Are you not good at **math**? I like English better than **Math**. I didn't study **math** at all.
english: mathematics
arabicDesc: مثال: هل انت لست جيدا في الرياضيات؟

paragraph: No one can wear a **mask** for very long. You must wear a **mask** on the shop floor. A friend of mine made it with a **mask**.
english: cover for the face

paragraph: What would you **advise** me to do? I like to **advise** people. She was **advised** by him to give up smoking.
english: to give advice to; to offer an opinion; to counsel; to warn

other.meaning: to give information or notice to; to inform

paragraph: You'll find what you need in that file **cabinet**. The Prime Minister appointed them to key **Cabinet** posts. The prime minister was unable to form a **cabinet**.
english: a cupboard; also the main group of government ministers

paragraph: Who is the woman dressed in **pink**? There is a lot of **pink** in their brain. Would you mind if I took the **pink** one?
english: pale red colour
arabicDesc: مثال: من تلك المرأة التي ترتدي فستاناً وردياً؟

other.meaning: Having a colour between red and white (adjective)

paragraph: Do you have a **crush** on her? He had a **crush** on her. The king **crushed** his enemies.
english: to press between two hard objects

paragraph: She is wearing a **valuable** ring. When a language disappears, **valuable** knowledge disappears with it. In those days, sugar was less **valuable** than salt.
english: having a great value

paragraph: Smoking is a bad **habit**. Once you start smoking, it is difficult to get rid of that bad **habit**. She's not in the **habit** of showing her feelings.
english: an action done on a regular basis

paragraph: I teach French at a nearby **junior** high school. He is **junior** to my brother by three years. I started to learn French in **junior** high school.
english: younger, or lower in rank

paragraph: His **discovery** gave rise to a revolution in transport. Chance led to the **discovery** of the new island. He set off on a journey of self-**discovery**.
english: something discovered

paragraph: The **mystery** of her death was never solved. What happened to them is still a **mystery**. What happened on that boat remained a **mystery**.
english: someone or something with an obscure or puzzling nature
arabicDesc: مثال: لم يُحل أبدا لغز وفاتها.

paragraph: The oil **filter** is tight and won't come off. When was the last time you replaced the **filter**? This **filter** turns the photos to black and white.
english: a device which separates a suspended, dissolved, or particulate matter from a fluid, solution, or other substance

other.meaning: any device or procedure that acts to separate or isolate

paragraph: The new method was anything but **ideal**. They are too busy fighting against each other to care for common **ideals**. The climate in the south of France is **ideal**.
english: being optimal
arabicDesc: مثال: الطريقة الجديدة لم تكن مثاليةً البتة.

paragraph: Does he have any **chocolate**? Have you been eating **chocolate**? I sent you a box of **chocolates**.
english: food made from ground roasted cocoa beans

paragraph: I must admit I don't like **contemporary** music much. The professor is familiar with **contemporary** literature. What do you think of **contemporary** art?
english: from the same time period, coexistent in time

paragraph: The author of this article is a famous **critic**. The **critic** considered every aspect of the defense program. He is the book **critic** for the local newspaper.
english: person who appraises the works of others
arabicDesc: مثال: محرر هذا المقال ناقد مشهور.

paragraph: Local businesses are teaming up for a charity **initiative**. I have no intention of financing such an **initiative**. Why don't women take the **initiative** in a relationship?
english: a beginning

paragraph: Don't forget to close the **tap** after you're finished. It isn't safe to drink the **tap** water here. I'm not used to drinking water from the **tap**.
english: to furnish (a container, etc.) with a tap (noun etymology 1, noun sense 2.2) so that liquid can be drawn

paragraph: I wanted a bigger **discount**. Is there a **discount** if you pay in cash? I might be able to get you a **discount**.
english: reduction in price

paragraph: He **advocated** the reduction of taxes. I am an **advocate** of free speech for everybody. He uses his voice to **advocate** for those in need.
english: someone whose job is to speak for someone's case in a court of law

other.meaning: person who speaks in support of something

paragraph: Do you know the French **equivalent** of the word? There is no German **equivalent** of this Japanese word. That French word has no **equivalent** in English.
english: similar or identical in value, meaning or effect

other.meaning: Anything that is virtually equal to something else, or has the same value, force, etc (noun)

paragraph: I can't get at the **exact** meaning of the sentence. The **exact** same thing happened to my friend a week later! Tell me the more **exact** time.
english: precisely agreeing with a standard, a fact, or the truth
arabicDesc: مثال: لا يمكنني فهم ما تعنيه هذه الجملة بالضبط.

paragraph: A marriage is a bond and a **moral** obligation. What's the **moral** that can be learnt from this story? **Moral** leadership is more powerful than any weapon.
english: of or relating to principles of right and wrong in behaviour, especially conforming to principles of rectitude

other.meaning: The ethical significance or practical lesson (noun)

paragraph: The **explanation** may be much more complex. The **explanation** was beyond my understanding. There is no time for **explanation**.
english: the act or process of explaining
arabicDesc: مثال: التفسير يمكن أن يكون أكثر تعقيدا.

paragraph: I always find myself **comforting** people with the words I want to hear. I prefer to be in my own **comfort** zone. He's afraid of stepping out of his **comfort** zone.
english: contentment, ease
arabicDesc: مثال: احاول أنا بإراحة الناس دائما بالكلمات التي ارغب أن اُقال

other.meaning: To relieve the distress or suffering of (verb)

paragraph: **Rob** told me the good news! Our house was **robbed** while we were away. I was **robbed** of my bag.
english: to steal from, especially using force or violence

paragraph: It led to the **establishment** of lasting peace. There are various **establishments** that run our society.
english: the act or process of establishing

paragraph: There is a very old **temple** in the town. How many tourists visit this **temple**? When was this **temple** built?
english: place of worship — see also place of worship
arabicDesc: مثال: هناك معبد قديم جدا في المدينة.

paragraph: He disappeared without a **trace**. How far back can you **trace** your family tree? The police will be able to **trace** the number.
english: mark left as a sign of passage

paragraph: If you can **silence** the king, you are the king. Speech is silver, **silence** is gold. **Silence** is a sign of consent.
english: lack of sound
arabicDesc: مثال: إن تمكنت من إسكات الملك، فأنت هو الملك.

paragraph: I really **regret** what I said to her yesterday. Do not write anything you may **regret** later. I promise you won't live to **regret** it.
english: feel sorry about some past thing
arabicDesc: مثال: ندمت بحق على ما قلته لها البارحة.

other.meaning: Emotional pain on account of something done or experienced in the past, with a wish that it had been different (noun)

paragraph: Law doesn't protect the **fools**. You had me completely **fooled**. When **fools** talk, wise ears take the evening off.
english: person with poor judgement or little intelligence

paragraph: Can you put the **belt** on the lowest hole? The details on the dress include a bright **belt**. You must always wear a seat **belt** when driving.
english: a band used as a restraint for safety purposes, such as a seat belt

other.meaning: band used in a machine to help transfer motion or power

paragraph: I replied **automatically** when I heard my name. If the screen doesn't change **automatically**, please click here. The door will lock **automatically** when you go out.
english: by itself, without a person doing it
arabicDesc: مثال: أجبته تلقائياً عندما سمعت اسمي.

paragraph: I can't believe you did all this without **external** help. **External** politics is something not easy to study. Speech is **external** thought, and thought internal speech.
english: outside of something

paragraph: I can't give you an **immediate** answer for that. You must not think about your **immediate** profit only. They needed to make a decision - an **immediate** decision.
english: happening right away, instantly, with no delay

paragraph: What do you think about the French **presidential** elections? He chose not to run for the **presidential** election. The town showed their anger during the **presidential** elections.
english: pertaining to a president or presidency

paragraph: She used to visit me **regularly**. Did you know that men who **regularly** take the birth control pill don't get pregnant? You'll have to visit me **regularly** for a while.
english: often and at regular times

paragraph: She earns a living from the **craft** of writing. Never forget to **craft** a bed on your first day. She focused on perfecting her **craft**.
english: intellectual power

paragraph: My nature doesn't allow me to break a **commitment**. I fear making a **commitment** and regretting it later. That's a level of **commitment** I could never compare to.
english: the act or an instance of committing, putting in charge, keeping, or trust, especially:

paragraph: Don't forget to **clock** out before you leave work. My alarm **clock** didn't go off this morning. The entire sales staff has worked around the **clock** for a week.
english: instrument to measure or keep track of time
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تنس أن تسجّل الوقت عند مغادرتك للعمل.

paragraph: I need your **approval** before I leave work early. You should not have done that without my **approval**. The developer needed city **approval** for his water plans.
english: an expression granting permission

paragraph: I **accompanied** him on the trip. He's not going to **accompany** the children to school. He is going to **accompany** you to the hospital.
english: to perform an accompanying part or parts in a composition

paragraph: How did a total **stranger** know his name? You're no **stranger** to the clinic. Well, **stranger** things have happened.
english: outsider or foreigner — see also foreigner
arabicDesc: مثال: كيف يعرف شخص أجنبيّ تماما اسمه؟

other.meaning: person whom one does not know

paragraph: He was attacked and eaten by a **lion**. A **lion** is a wild animal. The **lion** was waiting to spring.
english: big cat Panthera leo
arabicDesc: مثال: هجم عليه أسد و أكله.

paragraph: She wanted my **permission** to use the telephone. The teacher granted me **permission** to go home early. I plan to apply for **permission** to do that.
english: authorisation

paragraph: The **researcher** suggested promising directions for treating the cancer. He was a former university professor and **researcher**. He is a **researcher** of Japanese literature.
english: one who researches

paragraph: He does not let the **opponent** come near him. Never have I been so hard pressed by an **opponent**. The defeat was no surprise. The **opponent** was very strong.
english: one who opposes another

paragraph: I need to complete this **transaction** within one week. I must close this **transaction** within a week. Do you wish to make any other **transaction**?
english: the act of conducting or carrying out (business, negotiations, plans)

paragraph: The knife is not **sharp**. This knife is very **sharp**. The truck made a **sharp** turn to the right.
english: able to cut easily

paragraph: What's going on, **commissioner**? Are you seeing ghosts?
english: one who commissions something

paragraph: He got an overwhelming **urge** to punch someone in the face. They felt the **urge** to talk during the lesson. My **urge** to jump on him was taking over.
english: to press
arabicDesc: مثال: كان توم وماري مخطوبين لمدة ثلاثة أشهر قبل أن يتزوجا.
